title: Authentication settings: clearing a key (or resetting the namespace) answers saved, but the running value keeps the last stored one until a restart (lockout threshold, max sessions per user and siblings)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② a sibling of #30203, found and **measured** by its dev (PR #30309, os-dev-report 6650755695, out_of_scope class a). #30203 fixed one key (`allowed_ip_ranges`) only. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:server`, `plugin-auth` (`auth-plugin.ts` `applySettings`).
Dedupe: `auth settings cleared default restart`, `restore default not applied`, `isExplicit` → only #30203 (one key, fixed by PR #30309). **New.**

## What happens

`PUT /api/settings/auth` with a key set to `null` (the console's clear), or the namespace reset, answers saved. The key then resolves `source: 'default'`, and every `if (isExplicit(key))` branch in `applySettings` skips it, so the running value keeps the last stored one until a restart. Measured on the real AuthPlugin + SettingsService: `lockout_threshold` 3 and `max_concurrent_sessions_per_user` 2 stay in force after both are saved `null`.

## Wanted

- [ ] Every `isExplicit` branch in `applySettings` gets a reset arm that restores the key's deployment-declared value (stack config / plugin options), as PR #30309 did for `allowed_ip_ranges`.
- [ ] One pin per key family: save, clear, the running value is the declared one in the same pass.
- [ ] Coordinate with the refusable `emailAndPassword` / `mfa_required` pieces #30201 and #30202 are editing (PRs #30293, #30298); land after them or rebase on them.

Links: #30203, PR #30309, #30201, #30202.
